# bifrost_environment (Data Source)

Lee un entorno existente.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bifrost_environment" "prod" {
  app  = "tienda"
  name = "prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Set of String)
- `hosts` (List of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `internet` (Boolean)
- `namespace` (String)
- `quota` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quota))
- `services` (List of String) Ids de las herramientas añadidas.
- `status` (String)
